title: Dragon's Pass
author: Wade Clarke
description:
An envoy of the Dcasicil braves E'marka's mountain domain. A short interactive episode.

Author's comment: Dragon's Pass is one of several demonstration projects I wrote for a never-completed CYOA Framework extension for Inform 7. I previously released one of these demos, Captain Piedaterre's Blunders, as a standalone game. Looking at my files, it appears I last edited Dragon's Pass in 2016. The cover art is an adaptation of an Unsplash photo by Nitty Ditty.
